sentences.text:
Salim Ansari @ Md. Salim Ansari, aged about 27 years, Son of Md. Ishak
 Ansari, Resident of Village Levari, P.O. Bardiha and P.S. Manjhion, Bardiha
 and District- Garhwa (Jharkhand) ..... Petitioner
 Versus
1. The State of Jharkhand
2. Afsana Bibi S/o Salim Ansari, R/o Levari, P.O. and P.S. Bardiha, Dist-
 Garhwa, at present R/o village- Chattarpur, P.O. and P.S. and Dist- Garhwa
 .....Opposite Parties

Coram: Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Arun Kumar Rai
---------
For the Petitioner : Mr. Lal Chandrahas Nath, Advocate

For the State : Mr. Someshwar Roy, App
 For the O.P. No.2 : Mr. Vinod Kumar, Advocate

Petitioner is apprehending his arrest in connection with Complaint Case No. 425 of 2020 for the
offences registered under Sections 498A of the Indian Penal Code and 3/4 of D.P. Act, pending in
the court of learned J.M. 1st Class, Garhwa.

2.  Learned counsel for the petitioner drew attention of this Court regarding the report of mediator in which it is stated that on account of none presence of O.P. No.2/ wife, mediation could not take place.
He further pointed out that even otherwise petitioner is ready to keep the complainant with him.
Upon aforesaid premise prayer for anticipatory bail has been made.
3. Learned APP appearing for the State has opposed the prayer of anticipatory bail.

4. Mr. Vinod Kumar, learned counsel appeared on behalf of O.P. No.2/ wife and drew attention of this Court towards the complaint and submitted that it is the petitioner who inflicted cruelties to her on account of demand of dowry.
He further pointed out that petitioner is not paying the maintenance amount to O.P. No.2/ wife despite the order and direction of competent Court of law.

5. Heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the record.
6.

From perusal of the record, it transpires that complaint has been filed before learned Magistrate Salim Ansari @ Md. Salim Ansari vs The State Of Jharkhand on 1 October, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/154029588/
1 and learned Magistrate has summoned this petitioner under Section 489(A) of I.P.C. and 3/4 of D.P.
Act.
7.

entities.text: Salim Ansari @ Md. Salim Ansari vs The State Of Jharkhand
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
This is a complaint case and needless to say that complainant has to bring on record the evidence as per her wish.
8.

Considering the totality of aforesaid facts and circumstances, this Court finds it fit case for grant of anticipatory bail, accordingly, the petitioner named above, is directed to be released on bail on furnishing bail bonds of Rs. 10,000/- (Rupees ten thousand), with two sureties of the like amount each, to the satisfaction of learned J.M. 1st Class, Garhwa in connection with Complaint Case No.
425 of 2020, subject to the condition that petitioner shall appear on each and every date of hearing before the Court concerned except any medical exigency.

(Arun Kumar Rai, J.) Abhishek/
